_meta.description: Source registry for Phase 7B.3 plumbing market research. Each source referenced by service evidence rows. No source may be added without complete metadata.

sources.methodology_summary: Editorial price guide. No declared sampling method. Provides per-intervention ranges and per-city hourly rates. Scope notes generally present. Materials distinction not always explicit.
limitations: Single editorial source — no declared sample methodology
City hourly rates are editorial estimates, not observed transaction data
Material inclusion not always explicit per service
Upper ceiling values appear to include complex scope not separated from standard scope
sources.duplication_risk: LOW — inworky.com shows partial overlap but not verbatim copy
sources.notes: Most detailed single source found for city-level pricing and per-intervention breakdown. Treated as C+ quality. Consistent scope notes on materials improve usability.

sources.methodology_summary: Dedicated débouchage WC price guide from same publisher as SRC_PLUMBING_001. More granular on débouchage sub-methods (manual, professional, hydrocurage, camion). City-level breakdowns available.
limitations: Same publisher as SRC_PLUMBING_001 — not fully independent
Method sub-categories not always clearly scoped
City breakdown data extracted from partial fetch — may be incomplete
sources.duplication_risk: SAME_PUBLISHER — counted separately for débouchage specialisation only
sources.notes: Counted as half-weight independent source given same publisher. Only used where it provides additional scope detail not present in SRC_PLUMBING_001.

sources.methodology_summary: Artisan marketplace. States 119 plumbers listed in Casablanca. Provides a 'prix moyen honnête' statement for débouchage WC specifically, with explicit note that it includes 'matériel + déplacement'. This specific data point is the most reliable single-service Casablanca estimate found.
limitations: Casablanca only — no other city data
Most pages lack explicit pricing — only one service priced
Travel and materials included — requires normalization
sources.notes: Débouchage WC 300–450 DH Casablanca estimate is particularly credible as it comes from a marketplace with 119 listed artisans. Explicitly states travel included. Materials inclusion stated — must normalize to labour-only equivalent (roughly subtract 20–30 DH for consumables).

sources.methodology_summary: Artisan marketplace. States 34 plumbers listed in Marrakech. Provides price ranges for fuite and débouchage — materially lower than Casablanca equivalent from SRC_PLUMBING_003.
limitations: Marrakech only
Price ranges are editorial, not observed transaction data
34 artisans is smaller sample than Casablanca — less statistically grounded
sources.notes: Used for geographic comparison only — confirms Marrakech is 10–20% below Casablanca for equivalent services.

sources.methodology_summary: States 'prix moyen constaté' — implies observation-based pricing. Provides three services: fuite robinet/mitigeur, débouchage canalisation, remplacement chauffe-eau (pose seule). All forfait. Explicit note: materials excluded from 'pose seule' category.
limitations: Only 3 services with explicit pricing
Methodology not fully described despite 'prix constaté' claim
Not clear if 'canalisation' débouchage = évier or WC
sources.duplication_risk: LOW — ranges differ from other sources
sources.notes: Treated as C+ because 'prix constaté' implies actual observation rather than pure editorial. Cross-checks favorably with afous.ma for the same 3 services.

sources.methodology_summary: Detailed editorial guide from same publisher as SRC_PLUMBING_005. Covers 12 intervention types with duration estimates. Explicitly states prices exclude materials. Contains FAQ confirming diagnostic fee charged even if client does not proceed.
limitations: Same publisher as SRC_PLUMBING_005 — not fully independent
Purely editorial — no methodology statement
Casablanca/Rabat higher noted but no specific city values given
sources.notes: Most important contribution: explicit duration estimates per service (enabling economic floor validation), FAQ on diagnostic fee practice, and materials doctrine confirmation. Sanitaire prices are single-source — LOW weight.

sources.methodology_summary: Platform editorial price guide. Provides 5 service categories with ranges. Partially overlaps mano.ma ranges — possible editorial cross-referencing. Not verbatim copy — values differ enough to suggest independent research.
limitations: No methodology declared
Partial overlap with SRC_PLUMBING_001 ranges — reduced independence weight
Chauffe-eau installation likely includes equipment component based on upper range
sources.duplication_risk: MODERATE — counted at 0.5x weight where ranges overlap mano.ma
sources.notes: Used as corroborating source when it independently confirms other sources. Not used as primary source where ranges match SRC_PLUMBING_001 exactly.

sources.methodology_summary: Declared price observatory methodology: 2,475 'relevés terrain' total. P30–P70 trimming (30th–70th percentile band) excludes extreme values. 12-month trend tracking. Approximately 480 observations per service for the 3 services shown. 0% price change noted over 12 months (price stability indicator). Observations described as from clients and artisans.
limitations: Methodology declared but not independently auditable
'Relevés terrain' = self-reported by clients/artisans — potential response bias
Only 3 services covered
National aggregate — no city breakdown
Does not separate labour from materials — unclear if forfait includes consumables
480 observations per service: sufficient if distributed, insufficient if from few highly-active respondents
sources.duplication_risk: LOW — independent methodology and distinct values
sources.notes: Highest-quality external source found. P30–P70 method is correct for excluding outliers. 12-month stability (0% trend) is an important product finding. Weighted 0.50 in fair_price calculation where available. Used as the anchor for fuite_simple, debouchage, and chauffe-eau installation MO ranges.

sources.methodology_summary: Artisan or artisan cooperative self-published blog/site. Narrative format. Provides broad salary ranges for experienced plumbers and very broad service price ranges. No scope separation. No materials distinction.
limitations: No scope separation between service types
No materials/labour distinction
Self-published by a trade participant with potential price-setting motivation
Undated — recency unknown
Ranges too broad to be useful (200–500 DH simple repair, 3,000–10,000 DH installation)
sources.duplication_risk: N/A — excluded from all numeric evidence
sources.notes: Excluded from all price calculations. Retained only for artisan salary reference (5,000–8,000 DH/month for experienced plumber — used in economic floor analysis only).

sources.methodology_summary: Professional construction sector guide. Provides new-build plumbing cost reference (25,000–45,000 DH for 100m² house, all trades, all materials). Also provides material quality guidance and regulatory context (ONEE certification requirements for water connection).
limitations: New construction scope only — incompatible with maintenance/repair pricing
Includes all materials and all trades — cannot isolate labour
Not comparable to FIXEO service scope
sources.duplication_risk: N/A — excluded from all numeric evidence
sources.notes: Excluded from all price calculations. Retained for: (1) regulatory context (RADEEMA/ONEE agrément required for water connection), (2) material quality guidance (PVC forbidden in encastré; multicouche or cuivre required). These inform the materials doctrine.

sources.methodology_summary: App marketplace platform. Only snippet-level data retrieved: '120–240 DH' for general dépannage plomberie. No service breakdown. No scope information.
limitations: Snippet only — no full page content
No service scope definition
Very low range may reflect artisan self-pricing to attract volume (platform competitive pressure)
No materials/labour distinction
sources.notes: Used only as an artisan economic floor signal. 120–240 DH as an absolute floor for any Casablanca plumbing call-out. Values below this threshold in any source should be flagged as suspicious. Not used in any service price calculation.
